'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Matthew Harrison-Trainor DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Slavers.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
